description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It demonstrates network connectivity operations, including initiating a network request, handling user actions via menu items, and updating the UI with fetched data or errors. It interacts with a NetworkFragment to perform background network tasks asynchronously.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages user interactions and network status updates, coordinates network downloads, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting the layout, initializing UI components, and obtaining a NetworkFragment instance.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from a menu resource.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for initiating downloads or clearing data.

methods.name: startDownload
methods.description: Starts a network download if not already in progress.

methods.name: updateFromDownload
methods.description: Updates the TextView with fetched data or shows an error message.

methods.name: getActiveNetworkInfo
methods.description: Returns the current network information using ConnectivityManager.

methods.name: finishDownloading
methods.description: Stops ongoing download and cancels network operations.

methods.name: onProgressUpdate
methods.description: Provides updates on the progress of network operations, updating the UI.
